summary: The revision answers each of review 2's findings, F1 to F8, in docs/design/native-pr-landing.md. F1: it removes the claim that trailers survive a host merge and says in §5.1 step 5 and §5.3 that a landed job is found from records. It names the hand-built Co-authored-by test in §8. F2: it chooses one pull request per job (§5.6) and covers the M30 limits, naming, the many-to-one stealth mapping and the inherited previous_job gap. F3: §5.7 says the design supplies per-job pull requests, not automatic re-verification; it says how a stale job proceeds and that the roadmap order changes in a separate job. F4: it adds the unverified-merge risk and the merged-content check (§5.4, §8). F5: stealth writes no model Co-Authored-By unless asked, and the leak check tells Athena's own line from the host's. F6: the pull request number is stored in both modes and step 5 looks the merge up by it. F7: §10 lists the re-checked references. F8: §9 has four new questions, each with its assumption, and the status line is updated. I opened BRIEF.md 459-466, athena-v0-review-1.md 626-627, athena-v0.md 1446-1449, enforcement.md row M23, squash-chain-landing.md R2-M1 and invariant.rs 267-272, and each matches what the design says about it. Besides the design, only CHANGELOG.md and docs/decisions.md (new entry D85) change; both were listed as expected deliverables. Nothing under records/, reviews/, roadmap.md or the code changes.
